name: Mochi pet zoom fix
description: Stops the Mochi desktop pet from inheriting the dashboard's Zoom Level (TT P512647819): at any zoom other than 100% the pet overlay drew scaled and offset, strolled off-screen and could not be dragged. Two electron: patches give the pet overlay its own Chromium session partition (persist:mochi-pet) and pin its zoom to 1 after every load, in mochi/petOverlays.js and the older crew-companion/petOverlay.js inside the desktop shell's app.asar. Desktop bundles only; a gateway-only install skips it. Unofficial.

parts.description: electron:mochi/petOverlays.js — partition + zoomFactor on the pet overlay's webPreferences, setZoomFactor(1) after load
electron:crew-companion/petOverlay.js — the same two hunks for the older companion overlay; NotApplicable when the member is gone
